content:textarea:8:42.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:8:42.html: Did you know that 1 in 5 kids will go to bed hungry tonight or that 1 in 13 seniors have to choose between life-saving medication and food?
content:textarea:8:42.content: Did you know that 1 in 5 kids will go to bed hungry tonight or that 1 in 13 seniors have to choose between life-saving medication and food?

content:textarea:9:14.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:9:14.html: And did you know that 2,700 individuals in the Atlanta area won’t have a warm, safe place to sleep tonight?
content:textarea:9:14.content: And did you know that 2,700 individuals in the Atlanta area won’t have a warm, safe place to sleep tonight?

content:textarea:11:68.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:11:68.html: These are challenges many of our neighbors face every single day. They are real people with real struggles that threaten their families, threaten their health, threaten their hope that things will ever get better.
content:textarea:11:68.content: These are challenges many of our neighbors face every single day. They are real people with real struggles that threaten their families, threaten their health, threaten their hope that things will ever get better.

content:textarea:12:67.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:12:67.html: With your support, The Salvation Army of Metro Atlanta will meet these needs throughout metro Atlanta.
content:textarea:12:67.content: With your support, The Salvation Army of Metro Atlanta will meet these needs throughout metro Atlanta.

content:textarea:13:19.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:13:19.html: Ring The Bell ATL, and join us in our fight to bring aid, comfort and hope to those who need it!
content:textarea:13:19.content: Ring The Bell ATL, and join us in our fight to bring aid, comfort and hope to those who need it!

content:textarea:14:35.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:14:35.html: One gift can save one person… many can save many.
content:textarea:14:35.content: One gift can save one person… many can save many.

content:wysiwyg_basic:20:63.html:
<script>;
    (function (win) {
      win.egProps = {
        campaigns: [
          {
            campaignId: '527168',
	    customDomain: 'give.salvationarmygeorgia.org',
            donation: {
              modal: {
                urlParams: { },
                elementSelector: 'SELECTOR FROM YOUR WEBSITE'
              },
              // ADD ABANDON CART NUDGE CODE HERE TO ENABLE
            }
          }
        ]
      }
      win.document.body.appendChild(makeEGScript())
 
      /* Create the embed script */
      function makeEGScript() {
        var egScript = win.document.createElement('script')
        egScript.setAttribute('type', 'text/javascript')
        egScript.setAttribute('async', 'true')
        egScript.setAttribute('src', 'https://sdk.classy.org/embedded-giving.js')
        return egScript
      }
 
      /* Read URL Params from your website. This could potentially
        * be included in the embed snippet */
      function readURLParams() {
        const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
        const validUrlParams = ['c_src', 'c_src2']
        return validUrlParams.reduce(function toURLParamsMap(urlParamsSoFar, validKey) {
          const value = searchParams.get(validKey)
          return value === null ? urlParamsSoFar : { ...urlParamsSoFar, [validKey]: value }
        }, {})
      }
    })(window)
</script>
